name: gitmemory
description: Registers gitmemory's hook shim on PreCompact and SessionEnd, so a session is captured at the compaction boundary instead of at the watcher's next sweep. The hook is only a doorbell: nothing is captured unless the gitmemory watcher is installed (uv tool install git+https://github.com/doronp/gitmemory) and running, and without the hook gitmemory is still correct.
